decisions.reason: As an incremental component embedded in the established radiant-heating business, it is likely to be retained because its continued presence suggests no serious performance shortfall and the growing firm can absorb remaining uncertainty.

This electric infrared panel heater remains a strategic flagship in the shift toward lower-carbon building-climate solutions, so management would continue to tolerate experimentation and refine it rather than withdraw it.

Because this industrial electric infrared hall heater line is close to the firm's core applications and complements its broad system offering, management would likely keep it while using market feedback to improve fit and sales.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is strategically central to the firm's future direction and has already been demonstrated in real operation, making further development much more likely than discontinuation.
